title: Leave a little room for the unexpected
body: The best travel memories are often the places that were not on the plan. Keep your map open and let the day change shape.

title: Capture the ordinary, too
body: A familiar street, a favorite table, or the light on the walk home can become the detail you most want to remember.

title: Your book stays with you
body: Warang keeps moments and photographs on this phone. You can share a travelbook when you choose, with no account required.
